text:
Maya Chen: ran a regional sweep this morning comparing reranker/embedding throughput across GPU vs CPU, dims, and batch sizes. uploaded aggregated CSV + p50/p95 charts here: https://internal.redwood/perf/1769801234 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
PerfBot: benchmark artifact uploaded to perf-bucket/runs/1769801234.zip (checksums + raw logs)
Sasha Ivanov: nice. quick summary numbers? which GPUs/instances?
Maya Chen: TL;DR: g5.12xlarge (fp16/tensor cores) vs c6i.16xlarge (avx512) across us-west1 / europe-west1 / ap-southeast1. model: rerank-base-1 (1.2B) embeddings dims tested: 384, 768, 1536. batch sizes: 1, 8, 32, 64.
Maya Chen: p50 latency (embed, batch=8, dim=768): us-west1/gpu=12ms, eu/gpu=14ms, ap/cpu=85ms. throughput (items/sec, batch=32): gpu=4.7k, cpu=540.
Maya Chen: for reranker (batch=1, seq=128): p95 gpu=48ms, cpu=310ms.
Sasha Ivanov: wow 8-9x throughput gap for embeddings at 768 dim between gpus and cpus. did you try fused kernels / grouped GEMM?
Maya Chen: yes — two kernel modes: default (cuBLAS/cutlass fallback) and fused-attn path (our optimized fused matmul + kv cache). fused path gives ~1.25x throughput for dims>=768 on tensor-core GPUs, slightly higher p95 variance but lower p50.
Maya Chen: command used (simplified):
```
./run_batch_bench.sh --model rerank-base-1 --mode embed --dims 768,1536 --batches 1,8,32,64 --instances g5.12xlarge,c6i.16xlarge --regions us-west1,eu-west1,ap-southeast1 --kernels default,fused --quant none,int8
```
Ravi Patel: saw the int8 results? any quality drop on rerank MRR/Recall?
Maya Chen: int8 (post-training symmetric) boosted throughput ~1.8x on GPU for 1536-dim (batch32) but MRR dropped ~0.6 pts absolute on our TREC-like eval set (10k queries). tradeoff seems acceptable for non-prod or cold-path embeddings, not for high-precision reranks.
Jeff M.: did you test bf16 vs fp16? just curious about stability w/ fused kernels
Maya Chen: fp16 + tensor cores was stable. bf16 on CPU had small accuracy diff vs fp32 but slower than fp16 GPU. fused kernel currently only supported with fp16 on GPU.
Sasha Ivanov: region differences — was eu slower due to infra or model placement?
Maya Chen: eu had slightly worse p95 for small batches — traced to host CPU steal + NVLink contention on multi-tenant racks during that window. ap-southeast1 CPU runs had high variance (network-backed disks on the instances). we should avoid capacity commitments for CPU-only in ap for latency-sensitive workloads.
Ravi Patel: for capacity planning, any recommendation numbers for Dedicated pools?
Maya Chen: rough QoS plan: for embedding throughput (768d, target 5k items/sec): use 1 g5.12xlarge per 10k qps ingest with batching to 32. CPU fallback: 8 c6i.16xlarge per g5 (costly). for reranker latency SLO (p95 < 100ms): provision 1 GPU per 1.5k concurrent users at batch=1.
Sasha Ivanov: can we add kernel selection autoswitch? e.g., fused when dims>=768 and latency under X?
Maya Chen: yes that's next — I left a note in the perf issue tracker to gate fused kernel by model dims + region load. perf-bot attached the IDs: #PR-4221.
PerfBot: referenced perf issue PR-4221 and artifact 1769801234.zip
Jeff M.: thanks. can you add a short eval note re: int8 quality and a recommendation paragraph? will forward to solutions-eng.
Maya Chen: done — added `recommendation.txt` in the zip: "use int8 on GPU for high-throughput non-critical embeddings; avoid for reranker unless validated on customer prompt set. enable fused kernel for dims>=768 on GPUs; fall back to default on heavy NVLink contention."
Sasha Ivanov: cool. i'll schedule a quick 15m sync to decide rollout windows for fused kernel in eu.
Maya Chen: ping me when you schedule, i'll attach the regional logs for eu during the slower window. :calendar:
